description: This file contains functions and types for resolving command secrets via a gateway or locally, including handling secret references, web tools, and plugin configurations within a command-line interface context.

methods.name: pluginIdFromRuntimeWebPath
methods.description: Extracts plugin ID from a runtime web path if it matches specific pattern.

methods.name: normalizeCommandSecretResolutionMode
methods.description: Normalizes various input modes into a standard CommandSecretResolutionMode.

methods.name: enforcesResolvedSecrets
methods.description: Checks if the given mode enforces secrets to be resolved.

methods.name: dedupeDiagnostics
methods.description: Removes duplicate and whitespace-only entries from diagnostics array.

methods.name: targetsRuntimeWebPath
methods.description: Checks if a path is a runtime web path based on predefined prefixes.

methods.name: classifyRuntimeWebTargetPathState
methods.description: Classifies the state of a runtime web target path as active, inactive, or unknown based on config.

methods.name: describeInactiveRuntimeWebTargetPath
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description for why a runtime web target path is inactive.

methods.name: targetsRuntimeWebResolution
methods.description: Determines if any target IDs or allowed paths relate to runtime web paths.

methods.name: collectConfiguredTargetRefPaths
methods.description: Collects target reference paths from config based on target IDs.

methods.name: classifyConfiguredTargetRefs
methods.description: Classifies configured target references as active, unknown, or inactive, with diagnostics.

methods.name: parseGatewaySecretsResolveResult
methods.description: Validates and parses the secrets resolve result from the gateway.

methods.name: collectInactiveSurfacePathsFromDiagnostics
methods.description: Extracts paths marked as inactive from diagnostics messages.

methods.name: isUnsupportedSecretsResolveError
methods.description: Determines if an error is due to unsupported secrets.resolve method.

methods.name: isDirectRuntimeWebTargetPath
methods.description: Checks if a path directly corresponds to a runtime web target path pattern.

methods.name: resolveCommandSecretRefsLocally
methods.description: Resolves command secret references locally, handling web tools and inactive paths.

methods.name: buildTargetStatesByPath
methods.description: Builds a mapping of paths to their secret target states based on analysis.

methods.name: buildUnresolvedDiagnostics
methods.description: Generates diagnostics messages for unresolved secrets based on mode.

methods.name: scrubUnresolvedAssignments
methods.description: Removes unresolved secret assignments from config.

methods.name: filterInactiveSurfaceDiagnostics
methods.description: Filters out diagnostics related to inactive surface paths.

methods.name: resolveTargetSecretLocally
methods.description: Resolves a specific secret target locally, updating config and diagnostics.

methods.name: resolveCommandSecretRefsViaGateway
methods.description: Main function to resolve command secret references via gateway, with fallback to local resolution.
